members.name: selectedIds
members.doc: The ids of the selected ToggleButtons, when the caller controls the selection. A single-selection group holds at most one; the all value is not accepted.

members.name: defaultSelectedIds
members.doc: The ids of the ToggleButtons that start selected, when the group controls itself. A single-selection group holds at most one; the all value is not accepted.

members.name: selectionMode
members.doc: Whether the group selects one ToggleButton or several. Any other value throws a TypeError.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the group and every ToggleButton in it.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: The direction the buttons are laid out and the arrow keys move focus along.

members.name: disallowEmptySelection
members.doc: Keeps the selection from being cleared: the selected button stays selected when pressed again.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. The ToggleButtons take it from the group.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Called with the ids of the selected ToggleButtons each time the selection changes. A disabled group does not call it.
